enforcement_note: Nothing in this repository inspects a pipeline. These are read by a human or an agent looking at the diff.
condition: When changing build, deployment, containers, or pipeline configuration.
rule: Audit configuration handling, container posture and deploy reversibility, as questions.
ai_action: Work through the checklist against the code in question. Report the answers, including the ones that pass -- a checklist that only ever surfaces problems reads as noise. Where an answer is 'I cannot tell from here', say so rather than assuming the safe answer.

checklist.question: Is configuration supplied by the environment rather than committed per environment?
checklist.remediation_hint: Read from env vars; keep the repo environment-agnostic.

checklist.question: Are default credentials absent or disabled?
checklist.remediation_hint: Remove default accounts; require an explicit credential.

checklist.question: Is the secure setting the default, so forgetting a flag fails safe?
checklist.remediation_hint: Invert the flag so the unsafe path is opt-in.

checklist.question: Does the container run as a non-root user?
checklist.remediation_hint: Add a USER directive; drop capabilities.

checklist.question: Is the filesystem read-only where the workload does not need to write?
checklist.remediation_hint: Mount read-only; use a tmpfs for scratch.

checklist.question: Is the base image pinned and its provenance known?
checklist.remediation_hint: Pin by digest; rebuild on base updates.

checklist.question: Is there a way back that has been exercised, not just assumed?
checklist.remediation_hint: Practise the rollback before you need it.

checklist.question: Does the pipeline fail the build on a failing test rather than warning?

anti_pattern: Do not convert these questions into prescriptions. A question makes you look at the code and survives a codebase it was not written for; a prescription tells you what to type and stops being right the moment the context differs.

provenance.source: agent-generated; every item cites a source resolved on 2026-08-05
provenance.basis: Adopted from docs/checklist-system.md (Professional Hierarchical Checklist System + Golden Rule Research Protocol). Items phrased as review questions per the checklist-not-prescription rule.
